verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents issuing scoped or least-privilege API keys or tokens for an agent. The API docs only advise exploring "with read-only permissions where you can," which does not say credentials can be scoped. The Copilot admin controls (per-person access, Strict mode, a deletion block) govern the built-in assistant, not API credentials, so they are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
